verdicts.observation: tome-cults/data/lore/zones.lua:203 has 'I'm sure the spirits that haunt this place will rest easier knowing that there won't be any more victims'. Here 'rest easier' means the haunting spirits will be more at peace. The translation '鬼魂的工作，应该也会变得更轻松的吧' turns it into the ghosts' work getting easier, which inverts the meaning. It also softens 'I'm sure' into a guess. Separately, line 201 'no safety to be found within these walls' adds '玻璃幕墙', but the source only says walls; only the golems are made of glass.
unlock-demented_cultist_entropy.lua:30 'Rip apart spacetime to create rifts' is translated as '撕裂时间线'. Spacetime means 时空, not a timeline, so the class feature describes the wrong object.

fay-willows.lua:255 'if I remained within the Nargol city' is translated as '纳格尔王国'. That contradicts the source and the '纳格尔市场' earlier in the same entry: Nargol is a city here, not a kingdom. At line 253, 'When the guards finally moved in to clear them out' is translated as '搬进来清理', which misreads 'moved in' as relocating. The meaning is advancing to clear the area. At line 243, 'soon after the fires began to die down' is overstated as '完全熄灭了', and line 245 still says 'As the fires began to simmer', so the passage is now inconsistent.
